    Privacy Policy

    Effective Date: October 2026 • Last Updated: October 2026

    Gwyneth Ona (“I”, “me”, or “my”) operates “The Gwynther Times” portfolio and associated civic software platforms (including UmaAram and i-SkolarOS). This Privacy Policy explains how information is collected, used, and protected when you interact with this digital portfolio and contact forms.

    1. Information Collected

    When you use the contact form (“Letters to the Editor”) or interact with portfolio features, I may collect personal details such as your name, email address, subject, and message content. Technical metadata such as browser preferences and dark mode configurations are handled locally via client-side state.

    2. Use of Information

    Information submitted through contact channels is used exclusively to respond to professional inquiries, freelance correspondence, collaboration proposals, or feedback regarding civic deployments. Your data is never sold, bartered, or disclosed to third-party commercial entities.

    3. Data Security & Storage

    In accordance with zero-trust architectural standards, client submissions and digital communications are managed with rigorous privacy controls, restricted access, and minimization principles.

    4. Contact Information

    For questions regarding data privacy, correspondence can be directed to gwynethsophia.ona@unc.edu.ph.
